title.en: Volume 455 Biographies 214: Loyalty and Righteousness 10 - Chen Dong, Ouyang Che, Ma Shenhedui, Lu Zujian, Lu Zutai, Yang Hongzhong, Hua Yue, Deng Ruoshui, Seng Zhenbao, Mo Qianzhi, Xu Daoming
title.raw: 卷四百五十五 列傳第二百十四 忠義十 陳東 歐陽澈 馬伸何兌 呂祖儉 呂祖泰 楊宏中 華岳 鄧若水 僧眞寶 莫謙之 徐道明 Volume 455 Biographies 214: Loyalty and Righteousness 10 - Chen Dong, Ouyang Che, Ma Shenhedui, Lu Zujian, Lu Zutai, Yang Hongzhong, Hua Yue, Deng Ruoshui, Seng Zhenbao, Mo Qianzhi, Xu Daoming

sentences.zh: 忠義十

translations.literal: Loyalty and Righteousness, Ten
translations.idiomatic: Ten Biographies of Loyalty and Righteousness

sentences.zh: ○陳東歐陽澈馬伸呂祖儉呂祖泰楊宏中華嶽鄧若水僧真寶莫謙之徐道明

translations.literal: ○ Chen Dong, Ouyang Che, Ma Shen, Lü Zujian, Lü Zutai, Yang Hongzhong, Hua Yue, Deng Ruoshui, the monk Zhenbao, Mo Qianzhi, and Xu Daoming
translations.idiomatic: ○ Chen Dong, Ouyang Che, Ma Shen, Lü Zujian, Lü Zutai, Yang Hongzhong, Hua Yue, Deng Ruoshui, the monk Zhenbao, Mo Qianzhi, and Xu Daoming

sentences.zh: 李邦彥議與金和，李綱及種師道主戰，邦彥因小失利罷綱而割三鎮，東復率諸生伏宣德門下上書曰：

translations.literal: Li Bangyan argued for peace with the Jin; Li Gang and Zhong Shidao advocated war. Because of a minor setback, Bangyan had Gang dismissed and the Three Prefectures ceded. Dong again led the students to prostrate themselves beneath the Xuande Gate and submit a memorial, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Li Bangyan argued for making peace with the Jin, while Li Gang and Zhong Shidao urged war. Bangyan used a minor military setback as a pretext to remove Gang and cede the Three Prefectures. Chen Dong once more led the students to kneel before the Xuande Gate and submit a memorial that read:

sentences.zh: 在廷之臣，奮勇不顧、以身任天下之重者，李綱是也，所謂社稷之臣也。

translations.literal: Among the ministers at court, the one who acts with courageous disregard for his own safety and takes upon himself the weight of the realm is Li Gang—what is called a true minister of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Among the officials at court, the man who acts with fearless courage and bears the weight of the realm on his shoulders is Li Gang—the kind of minister the state truly needs.

sentences.zh: 其庸繆不才、忌疾賢能、動為身謀、不恤國計者，李邦彥、白時中、張邦昌、趙野、王孝迪、蔡懋、李棁之徒是也，所謂社稷之賊也。

translations.literal: Those who are mediocre and erring, without talent, jealous of the worthy and able, who in every move scheme for themselves and do not care for the nation's plans—Li Bangyan, Bai Shizhong, Zhang Bangchang, Zhao Ye, Wang Xiaodi, Cai Mao, Li Zhuo, and the like—are what are called enemies of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Those who are incompetent and corrupt, who envy talent, who in every action serve themselves and not the nation—Li Bangyan, Bai Shizhong, Zhang Bangchang, Zhao Ye, Wang Xiaodi, Cai Mao, Li Zhuo, and their kind—are enemies of the state.

sentences.zh: 陛下拔綱列卿之中，不一二日為執政，中外相慶，知陛下之能任賢矣。

translations.literal: Your Majesty plucked Gang from among the ministers, and within a day or two made him chief minister. Within and without the court all rejoiced, knowing that Your Majesty could appoint the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty raised Li Gang from among the ministers and within a day or two made him chief minister. The court and the country rejoiced alike, for they saw that Your Majesty knew how to appoint the worthy.

sentences.zh: 斥時中而不用，知陛下之能去邪矣。

translations.literal: You dismissed Shizhong and did not employ him, showing that Your Majesty could remove the wicked.
translations.idiomatic: You dismissed Bai Shizhong and refused to employ him, showing that Your Majesty knew how to remove the wicked.

sentences.zh: 然綱任而未專，時中斥而未去，復相邦彥，又相邦昌，自餘又皆擢用，何陛下任賢猶未能勿貳，去邪猶未能勿疑乎？

translations.literal: Yet Gang was appointed but not given full authority; Shizhong was dismissed but not removed; Bangyan was again made chief minister, and Bangchang was again made chief minister; and the rest were all promoted and employed. How is it that in appointing the worthy Your Majesty still cannot be single-minded, and in removing the wicked still cannot be resolute?
translations.idiomatic: Yet Li Gang was given office but not full authority; Bai Shizhong was dismissed but not driven out; Li Bangyan was again made chief minister, and Zhang Bangchang was again made chief minister; and the rest were all promoted as well. How can Your Majesty still be undecided in appointing the worthy, and still hesitate in removing the wicked?

sentences.zh: 今又聞罷綱職事，臣等驚疑，莫知所以。

translations.literal: Now we further hear that Gang's duties have been terminated. We your subjects are startled and perplexed, and do not know the reason.
translations.idiomatic: Now we hear that Li Gang has been removed from office. We are shocked and bewildered, and do not know why.

sentences.zh: 綱起自庶官，獨任大事。

translations.literal: Gang rose from a common official and alone undertook great affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang rose from a lowly post and alone shouldered the greatest responsibilities of state.

sentences.zh: 邦彥等疾如仇讎，恐其成功，因用兵小不利，遂得乘閑投隙，歸罪於綱。

translations.literal: Bangyan and the others hated him as if he were a mortal enemy, fearing his success. Seizing on a minor military disadvantage, they found an opening and cast the blame upon Gang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bangyan and his faction hated him like a mortal enemy and feared his success. Exploiting a minor setback in the war, they seized the opportunity to shift all blame onto Li Gang.

sentences.zh: 夫一勝一負，兵家常勢，豈可遽以此傾動任事之臣。

translations.literal: One victory and one defeat are the common pattern of warfare. How can one so hastily use this to overturn a minister charged with affairs?
translations.idiomatic: Victory and defeat are the common pattern of war. How can a single setback be used so hastily to bring down the minister entrusted with the nation's affairs?

sentences.zh: 竊聞邦彥、時中等盡勸陛下他幸，京城騷動，若非綱為陛下建言，則乘輿播遷，宗廟社稷已為丘墟，生靈已遭魚肉。

translations.literal: We privately hear that Bangyan, Shizhong, and the rest all urged Your Majesty to go elsewhere. The capital was in turmoil. Had Gang not offered counsel to Your Majesty, the imperial carriage would have been driven into exile, the ancestral temples and altars of state would already lie in ruins, and the people would already have been slaughtered like fish on the chopping block.
translations.idiomatic: We have heard that Li Bangyan, Bai Shizhong, and the others all urged Your Majesty to flee the capital. The city was in turmoil. If Li Gang had not counseled Your Majesty to stay, the imperial carriage would have been driven into exile, the ancestral temples would lie in ruins, and the people would have been slaughtered like fish on a block.

sentences.zh: 賴聰明不惑，特從其請，宜邦彥等讒嫉無所不至。

translations.literal: Thanks to Your Majesty's clear wisdom and freedom from delusion, you specially followed his request. It is no wonder that Bangyan and the others slandered and envied him without limit.
translations.idiomatic: Because Your Majesty's wisdom was clear and you heeded his counsel, it is no wonder that Li Bangyan and his allies slandered and envied him without restraint.

sentences.zh: 陛下若聽其言，斥綱不用，宗社存亡，未可知也。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty listens to their words and dismisses Gang and does not employ him, whether the altars of state will survive is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty listens to them and dismisses Li Gang, the survival of the dynasty itself will be in doubt.

sentences.zh: 邦彥等執議割地，蓋河北實朝廷根本，無三關四鎮，是棄河北，朝廷能復都大梁乎？

translations.literal: Bangyan and the others held to the plan of ceding territory. Hebei is in truth the foundation of the court. Without the Three Passes and Four Prefectures, that is to abandon Hebei. Can the court then return its capital to Daliang?
translations.idiomatic: Li Bangyan and his faction advocated ceding territory. Hebei is the very foundation of the dynasty. Without the Three Passes and Four Prefectures, Hebei would be abandoned—and could the court ever return its capital to Kaifeng?

sentences.zh: 則不知割太原、中山、河間以北之後，邦彥等能使金人不復敗盟乎？

translations.literal: Then do they not know that after ceding Taiyuan, Zhongshan, and the territory north of Hejian, can Bangyan and the others make the Jin people not again break the alliance?
translations.idiomatic: Do they imagine that after ceding Taiyuan, Zhongshan, and everything north of Hejian, Li Bangyan and his allies can somehow keep the Jin from breaking the treaty again?

sentences.zh: 一進一退，在綱為甚輕，朝廷為甚重。

translations.literal: One advance and one retreat are very light for Gang, but very heavy for the court.
translations.idiomatic: A single advance or retreat may seem a small matter for Li Gang, but for the court it is a matter of grave consequence.

sentences.zh: 幸陛下即反前命，復綱舊職，以安中外之心，付種師道以閫外之事。

translations.literal: We pray that Your Majesty will immediately reverse the previous order, restore Gang to his former office to settle the hearts within and without, and entrust Zhong Shidao with affairs beyond the capital.
translations.idiomatic: We beg Your Majesty to revoke your previous order at once, restore Li Gang to his former post to reassure the court and the country, and entrust military affairs beyond the capital to Zhong Shidao.

sentences.zh: 陛下不信臣言，請遍問諸國人，必皆曰綱可用，邦彥等可斥也。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty does not believe our words, please ask widely among the people of the realm. All will surely say that Gang should be employed and Bangyan and the others should be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty does not believe us, ask anyone in the realm—you will find that all say Li Gang should be kept and Li Bangyan and his faction should be removed.

sentences.zh: 用舍之際，可不審諸！

translations.literal: At the moment of employing or dismissing men, can one fail to examine the matter carefully!
translations.idiomatic: When choosing whom to employ and whom to dismiss, how can Your Majesty fail to weigh the matter with the utmost care!

sentences.zh: 軍民從者數萬。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians who followed numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians who joined them numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 書聞，傳旨慰諭者旁午，眾莫肯去，方舁登聞鼓撾壞之，喧呼震地。

translations.literal: When the memorial was received, imperial messengers came in rapid succession to comfort and instruct them, but the crowd refused to leave. They then raised the Petition Drum and smashed it; their clamor shook the earth.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, imperial envoys came one after another to soothe the crowd, but the people refused to disperse. They raised the Petition Drum and smashed it, and their uproar shook the ground.

sentences.zh: 有中人出，眾臠而磔之。

translations.literal: A eunuch came out, and the crowd tore him apart and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: When a eunuch emerged, the crowd tore him limb from limb and killed him.

sentences.zh: 於是亟詔綱入，復領行營，遣撫諭，乃稍引去。

translations.literal: Thereupon an urgent edict summoned Gang to enter the capital. He again took command of the field army. The court sent envoys to soothe the people, and only then did they gradually withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: The court then urgently summoned Li Gang back and restored him to command of the field army. After envoys were sent to pacify the crowd, the people finally began to disperse.

sentences.zh: 金人既解去，學官觀望，時宰議屏伏闕之士，先自東始。

translations.literal: After the Jin forces had withdrawn, the education officials wavered. The chief ministers planned to remove the students who had prostrated themselves at the palace gate, beginning with Dong.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Jin army had withdrawn, the education officials wavered. The chief ministers resolved to punish the students who had knelt at the palace gate, starting with Chen Dong.

sentences.zh: 京尹王時雍欲盡致諸生於獄，人人惴恐。

translations.literal: The capital magistrate Wang Shiyong wished to throw all the students into prison, and everyone trembled with fear.
translations.idiomatic: The capital prefect Wang Shiyong wanted to imprison every student involved, and fear spread among them all.

sentences.zh: 朝廷用楊時為祭酒，復東職，遣聶山詣學撫諭，然後定。

translations.literal: The court appointed Yang Shi as libationer of the Imperial Academy, restored Dong's office, and sent Nie Shan to the academy to soothe and instruct them; only then was the matter settled.
translations.idiomatic: The court appointed Yang Shi as libationer of the Imperial Academy, restored Chen Dong to his post, and sent Nie Shan to the academy to calm the students—and only then did the crisis subside.

sentences.zh: 吳敏欲弭謗，議奏補東官，賜第，除太學錄。

translations.literal: Wu Min wished to still slander and proposed memorializing to appoint Dong to office, grant him a mansion, and appoint him recorder of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Min, seeking to quell the controversy, proposed appointing Chen Dong to office, granting him an official residence, and making him a recorder of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 東又請誅蔡氏，且力辭官以歸，前後書五上。

translations.literal: Dong again requested the execution of the Cai faction, and forcefully declined office to return home. In all he submitted five memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dong again demanded that the Cai faction be punished, and firmly refused office so that he could return home. In all he submitted five memorials.

sentences.zh: 既歸，復預鄉薦。

translations.literal: After he returned, he again passed the provincial recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: After returning home, he again passed the provincial examination for official recommendation.

sentences.zh: 高宗即位五日，相李綱，又五日召東至。

translations.literal: Five days after Gaozong ascended the throne, he made Li Gang chief minister. Five days later he summoned Dong to court.
translations.idiomatic: Five days after Emperor Gaozong took the throne, he appointed Li Gang chief minister. Five days after that he summoned Chen Dong to court.

sentences.zh: 未得對，會綱去，乃上書乞留綱而罷黃潛善、汪伯彥。

translations.literal: Before he could be received in audience, Gang departed office. Dong thereupon submitted a memorial begging that Gang be retained and that Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Before Chen Dong could be received in audience, Li Gang had already left office. Dong then submitted a memorial asking that Li Gang be kept in power and that Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan be removed.

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: There was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: The court gave no reply.

sentences.zh: 請親征以還二聖，治諸將不進兵之罪，以作士氣；

translations.literal: He requested a personal expedition to recover the Two Emperors and punish the generals who failed to advance, so as to raise the morale of the troops.
translations.idiomatic: He urged the emperor to lead a personal campaign to recover the two captive emperors and punish the generals who had failed to advance, so as to restore the army's fighting spirit.

sentences.zh: 車駕歸京師，勿幸金陵。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage should return to the capital and not go to Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage should return to the capital and not withdraw to Jinling.

sentences.zh: 又不報。

translations.literal: Again there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Again there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 潛善輩方揭示綱幸金陵舊奏，東言綱在中途，不知事體，宜以後說為正，必速罷潛善輩。

translations.literal: Qianshan and his faction had just posted Gang's old memorial about going to Jinling. Dong said that Gang, being still on the road, had not known the full situation, and that his later statements should be taken as authoritative. Qianshan and his faction must be dismissed at once.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Qianshan and his allies had just posted Li Gang's earlier memorial urging withdrawal to Jinling. Chen Dong argued that Gang, still en route at the time, had not known the full situation, and that his later statements should prevail. Huang Qianshan and his faction must be removed immediately.

sentences.zh: 會布衣歐陽澈亦上書言事，潛善遽以語激怒高宗，言不亟誅，將復鼓眾伏闕。

translations.literal: At this time the commoner Ouyang Che also submitted a memorial on state affairs. Qianshan quickly used his words to enrage Gaozong, saying that if they were not executed at once, the crowd would again be stirred to prostrate themselves at the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time the commoner Ouyang Che also submitted a memorial on affairs of state. Huang Qianshan swiftly used Che's words to inflame Gaozong, warning that unless the two men were executed immediately, they would again rouse crowds to kneel at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 書獨下潛善‘所。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down only to Qianshan's office.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was routed solely to Huang Qianshan's office.

sentences.zh: 府尹孟庾召東議事，東請食而行，手書區處家事，字畫如平時，已乃授其從者曰：“我死，爾歸致此於吾親。”

translations.literal: The prefect Meng Yu summoned Dong to discuss affairs. Dong asked for food before going, and by hand wrote instructions for household matters; the characters were as in ordinary times. Then he handed it to his attendant, saying: "When I die, you return and deliver this to my parents."
translations.idiomatic: The prefect Meng Yu summoned Chen Dong to discuss the matter. Dong asked for a meal before setting out and wrote out arrangements for his household affairs by hand; his script was as steady as ever. He then handed the note to his attendant and said, "When I am dead, take this home to my parents."

sentences.zh: 食已如廁，吏有難色，東笑曰：“我陳東也，畏死即不敢言，已言肯逃死乎？”

translations.literal: After he had eaten he went to the privy. An officer looked troubled. Dong laughed and said: "I am Chen Dong. If I feared death I would not have spoken; having spoken, would I flee from death?"
translations.idiomatic: After he had eaten, he went to relieve himself. An officer looked uneasy. Dong laughed and said, "I am Chen Dong. If I feared death I would never have spoken out; and having spoken, would I now run from it?"

sentences.zh: 吏曰：“吾亦知公，安敢相迫。”

translations.literal: The officer said: "I too know you, sir. How would I dare press you?"
translations.idiomatic: The officer replied, "I know who you are, sir. How could I dare to pressure you?"

sentences.zh: 頃之，東具冠帶出，別同邸，乃與澈同斬於市。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Dong put on cap and sash and came out, took leave of those in the same lodging, and was then executed in the marketplace together with Che.
translations.idiomatic: A moment later Chen Dong dressed in full cap and sash, bid farewell to those sharing his lodging, and was executed in the marketplace together with Ouyang Che.

sentences.zh: 四明李猷贖其屍瘞之。

translations.literal: Li You of Siming redeemed their corpses and buried them.
translations.idiomatic: Li You of Siming ransomed their bodies and gave them burial.

sentences.zh: 東初未識綱，特以國故，至為之死，識與不識皆為流涕。

translations.literal: At first Dong did not even know Gang personally; he acted purely for the sake of the state and went so far as to die for him. Whether they knew him or not, all wept.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dong had not even known Li Gang personally; he acted purely out of loyalty to the state and went so far as to die for him. All who heard of it wept, whether they had known him or not.

sentences.zh: 時年四十有二。

translations.literal: He was forty-two years of age.
translations.idiomatic: He was forty-two years old.

sentences.zh: 潛善既殺二人，明日府尹白事，獨詰其何以不先關白，微示慍色，以明非己意。

translations.literal: After Qianshan had killed the two men, the next day when the prefect reported on affairs, he alone questioned why he had not been notified beforehand, showing slight anger to make clear that it was not his own wish.
translations.idiomatic: After Huang Qianshan had the two men killed, the prefect reported to court the next day and Qianshan alone rebuked him for failing to notify him in advance, feigning indignation to make clear the killings had not been his wish.

sentences.zh: 越三年，高宗感悟，追贈東、澈承事郎。

translations.literal: Three years later Gaozong came to his senses and posthumously granted Dong and Che the rank of Court Gentleman for Miscellaneous Service.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later Emperor Gaozong came to his senses and posthumously granted Chen Dong and Ouyang Che the rank of Court Gentleman for Miscellaneous Service.

sentences.zh: 東無子，官有服親一人，澈一子，令州縣撫其家。

translations.literal: Dong had no son; one close relative in official mourning was recorded for him. Che had one son. The court ordered the prefectures and counties to support their households.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dong had no son; one close relative in mourning was entered on the official register on his behalf. Ouyang Che had one son. The court ordered local officials to provide for their families.

sentences.zh: 及駕過鎮江，遣守臣祭東墓，賜緡錢五百。

translations.literal: When the imperial procession passed through Zhenjiang, the emperor sent the local official to offer sacrifice at Dong's tomb and granted five hundred strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial procession passed through Zhenjiang, the emperor sent the local magistrate to offer sacrifice at Chen Dong's tomb and granted five hundred strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 紹興四年，並加朝奉郎、秘閣修撰，官其後二人，賜田十頃。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shaoxing, both were further promoted to Recipient of Tributes from the Court and Compiler in the Secretariat Archive. Offices were granted to two of their descendants, and ten qing of land were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Shaoxing reign, both were further promoted to Recipient of Tributes from the Court and Compiler in the Secretariat Archive. Two of their descendants were given official posts, and ten qing of land were granted.

sentences.zh: 歐陽澈，字德明，撫州崇仁人。

translations.literal: Ouyang Che, courtesy name Deming, was a native of Chongren in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Che, courtesy name Deming, was a native of Chongren in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 年少美須眉，善談世事，尚氣大言，慷慨不少屈，而憂國閔時，出於天性。

translations.literal: In youth he had handsome beard and brows. He was skilled at discussing affairs of the day, spirited in speech and bold in words, generous and never easily yielding. His concern for the state and grief for the times sprang from his inborn nature.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth he was handsome, with fine brows and beard. He was skilled at discussing current affairs, spoke with bold spirit and never easily yielded. His love of country and grief for the age came from his very nature.

sentences.zh: 靖康初，應製條敝政，陳安邊禦敵十策，州未許發。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jingkang era he responded to the imperial examination on defective policies and submitted ten strategies for securing the borders and repelling the enemy, but the prefecture did not permit it to be sent.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Jingkang era he entered the imperial examination on defective policies and submitted ten strategies for securing the borders and repelling the enemy, but the prefectural authorities would not forward the memorial.

sentences.zh: 退而復采朝廷之闕失，政令之乖違，可以為保邦禦俗之方、去蠹國殘民之賊者十事，復為書，並上聞。

translations.literal: He withdrew and again gathered the court's failures and the violations of policy and command—ten matters that could serve as methods for protecting the state and guarding the people, and for removing the pests that devoured the nation and harmed the people—wrote another memorial, and submitted both together.
translations.idiomatic: He withdrew and compiled ten further matters—failures of the court and violations of policy that, if corrected, could protect the state, safeguard the people, and root out those who devoured the nation and preyed on the populace—wrote another memorial, and submitted both together.

sentences.zh: 已而復論列十事，言：“臣所進三書實為切要，然而觸權臣者有之，迕天聽者有之，或結怨富貴之門，或遺怒台諫之官，臣非不知，而敢抗言者，願以身而安天下也。”

translations.literal: Later he again enumerated ten matters, saying: "The three memorials I have submitted are truly urgent and essential. Yet some have offended powerful ministers; some have gone against the imperial ear; some have made enemies of the gates of the wealthy; some have provoked the anger of the censorial and remonstrance officials. I am not unaware of this, yet I dare speak out because I wish to use my own body to bring peace to the realm."
translations.idiomatic: He later submitted ten more points, writing: "The three memorials I have submitted address matters of urgent necessity. Some have offended powerful ministers; some have displeased the throne; some have made enemies among the great families; some have provoked the censorial and remonstrance officials. I know all this, yet I speak because I am willing to sacrifice my own life to secure peace for the realm."

sentences.zh: 所上書為三巨軸，廄置卒辭不能舉，州將為選力士荷之以行。

translations.literal: The memorials he submitted filled three huge scrolls. A stable soldier said he could not lift them, so the prefectural commander selected strong men to carry them on their shoulders.
translations.idiomatic: The memorials he submitted filled three enormous scrolls. A stable guard said he could not lift them, so the prefect selected strong men to carry them on their shoulders.

sentences.zh: 許翰在政府，罷朝，問潛善處分何人，曰：“斬陳東、歐陽澈耳。”

translations.literal: Xu Han was in the central government. After court he asked whom Qianshan was punishing. Qianshan said: "Execute Chen Dong and Ouyang Che."
translations.idiomatic: Xu Han served in the central government. After court he asked whom Huang Qianshan intended to punish. Qianshan replied, "Execute Chen Dong and Ouyang Che."

sentences.zh: 翰驚失色，因究其書何以不下政府，曰：“獨下潛善，故不得以相視。”

translations.literal: Han was shocked and turned pale. He then inquired why the memorial had not been sent down to the central government. The answer was: "It was sent down only to Qianshan, so it could not be reviewed together."
translations.idiomatic: Xu Han was shocked and turned pale. He then asked why the memorial had not been routed to the central government. The answer was, "It was sent down only to Huang Qianshan's office, so we could not review it together."

sentences.zh: 遂力求罷。

translations.literal: He thereupon strove with all his strength to have himself dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He then pressed vigorously for his own dismissal from office.

sentences.zh: 為東、澈著哀詞。

translations.literal: He composed elegies for Dong and Che.
translations.idiomatic: He composed elegies for Chen Dong and Ouyang Che.

sentences.zh: 澈所著《飄然集》六卷，會稽胡衍既刻之，豐城範應鈐為之祠學中。

translations.literal: Che's collected works, the Piaoran Collection in six volumes, were printed by Hu Yan of Kuaiji, and Fan Yingqian of Fengcheng erected a shrine to him in the academy.
translations.idiomatic: Che's collected works, the Piaoran Collection in six volumes, were printed by Hu Yan of Kuaiji, and Fan Yingqian of Fengcheng erected a shrine to him in the academy.

sentences.zh: 馬伸，字時中，東平人。

translations.literal: Ma Shen, courtesy name Shizhong, was a native of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shen, courtesy name Shizhong, was a native of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 紹聖四年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of Shaosheng.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of the Shaosheng reign.

sentences.zh: 不樂馳騖，每調官，未嚐擇便利。

translations.literal: He did not enjoy rushing about. Whenever he was transferred to a post, he never chose what was convenient.
translations.idiomatic: He did not enjoy chasing after advancement. Whenever he was assigned to a post, he never chose the easy or convenient appointment.

sentences.zh: 為成都郫縣丞，守委受成都租。

translations.literal: As assistant magistrate of Pi County in Chengdu, the prefect entrusted him with collecting the Chengdu land tax.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as assistant magistrate of Pi County in Chengdu, the prefect entrusted him with collecting the Chengdu land tax.

sentences.zh: 前受輸者率以食色玩好蠱訹而敗，伸請絕宿弊。

translations.literal: Previous collectors had generally been ruined by using food, women, and fine objects to corrupt and intimidate people. Shen requested that this longstanding abuse be ended.
translations.idiomatic: Previous collectors had usually been ruined by using feasts, women, and luxuries to bribe and intimidate the people. Ma Shen demanded an end to this longstanding abuse.

sentences.zh: 民爭先輸，至沿途假寐以達旦，常平使者孫俟早行，怪問之，皆應曰：“今年馬縣丞受納，不病我也。”

translations.literal: The people competed to pay ahead of schedule. Some even napped along the road until dawn. The Ever-Normal Granary commissioner Sun Si, traveling early, wondered at this and asked. All answered: "This year Magistrate Ma is receiving payments, and he does not harm us."
translations.idiomatic: The people competed to pay their taxes early. Some even dozed along the road until dawn. The Ever-Normal Granary commissioner Sun Si, traveling early, was puzzled and asked why. All answered, "This year Magistrate Ma is collecting the tax, and he does not harm us."

sentences.zh: 俟薦於朝。

translations.literal: Si recommended him to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Si recommended him to the court.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，範致虛攻程頤為邪說，下河南府盡逐學徒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Chongning era, Fan Zhixu attacked Cheng Yi as heterodox doctrine, and the Henan prefectural government drove out all the students.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Chongning era, Fan Zhixu denounced Cheng Yi as a purveyor of heterodox doctrine, and the Henan prefectural government expelled all his students.

sentences.zh: 伸注西京法曹，欲依頤門以學，因張繹求見，十反愈恭，頤固辭之。

translations.literal: Shen was posted to the legal bureau of the Western Capital. Wishing to study under Yi's school, he sought an introduction through Zhang Yi. He visited ten times, each time more deferential, but Yi firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shen was posted to the legal bureau of the Western Capital. Wishing to study under Cheng Yi's school, he sought an introduction through Zhang Yi. He visited ten times, growing more respectful each time, but Yi firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 伸欲休官而來，頤曰：“時論方異，恐貽子累，子能棄官，則官不必棄也。”

translations.literal: Shen wished to resign his office and come. Yi said: "Current opinion is just then hostile. I fear it would bring calamity upon you. If you can abandon office, then office need not be abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shen wanted to resign his post and come study in person. Cheng Yi said, "Opinion at court is hostile just now. I fear it would bring disaster upon you. If you are willing to give up your office, then your office need not be given up."

sentences.zh: 曰：“使伸得聞道，死何憾，況未必死乎？”

translations.literal: Shen said: "If Shen can hear the Way, what regret would there be in death—and besides, I may not die at all."
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shen replied, "If I can learn the Way, what regret is there in death? And besides, I may not die at all."

sentences.zh: 頤歎其有誌，進之。

translations.literal: Yi sighed at his resolve and admitted him.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yi admired his resolve and accepted him as a student.

sentences.zh: 自是公暇雖風雨必日一造，忌娼者飛語中傷之，弗顧，卒受《中庸》以歸。

translations.literal: From then on, even in wind and rain he visited once every day in his free time. Jealous courtesans spread slanderous rumors to harm him, but he paid no heed and in the end received the Doctrine of the Mean and returned.
translations.idiomatic: From then on he visited every day in his free time, even in wind and rain. Jealous courtesans spread slanderous rumors against him, but he ignored them and in the end completed his study of the Doctrine of the Mean and returned home.

sentences.zh: 靖康初，孫傅以卓行薦召，御史中丞秦檜迎辟之，擢監察御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jingkang era, Sun Fu recommended him for his outstanding conduct and he was summoned to court. The censor-in-chief Qin Hui welcomed him onto his staff, and he was promoted to supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Jingkang era, Sun Fu recommended him for his outstanding character and he was summoned to court. The censor-in-chief Qin Hui welcomed him onto his staff, and he was promoted to supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 及汴京陷，金人立張邦昌，集百官，環以兵脅之，俾推戴。

translations.literal: When Bianjing fell, the Jin people established Zhang Bangchang, gathered the officials, surrounded them with troops, and coerced them to endorse him.
translations.idiomatic: When Bianjing fell, the Jin established Zhang Bangchang as ruler, assembled the officials, surrounded them with troops, and forced them to acclaim him.

sentences.zh: 眾唯唯，伸獨奮曰：“吾職諫爭，忍坐視乎！”

translations.literal: The crowd murmured assent. Shen alone roused himself and said: "My duty is remonstrance and dispute. How can I sit by and watch!"
translations.idiomatic: The others murmured their assent. Ma Shen alone spoke up boldly: "My duty is to remonstrate. How can I sit by and do nothing!"

sentences.zh: 乃與御史吳給約秦檜共為議狀，乞存趙氏，復嗣君位。

translations.literal: He then joined with the censor Wu Ge in agreeing with Qin Hui to draft jointly a petition begging that the Zhao house be preserved and the succession restored.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined the censor Wu Ge and Qin Hui in drafting a joint petition asking that the Zhao dynasty be preserved and the rightful succession restored.

sentences.zh: 會統製官吳革起義，募兵圖復二帝，伸預其謀。

translations.literal: When the system commander Wu Ge rose in rebellion, recruited troops, and plotted to recover the Two Emperors, Shen took part in the plan.
translations.idiomatic: When the system commander Wu Ge raised a rebellion, recruited troops, and plotted to recover the two captive emperors, Ma Shen took part in the scheme.

sentences.zh: 邦昌既僭立，賊臣多從臾之，伸首具書請邦昌速迎奉元帥康王。

translations.literal: After Bangchang had usurped the throne, many treacherous ministers urged him on. Shen was the first to draw up a full memorial begging Bangchang to hurry and welcome and serve Marshal Prince Kang.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhang Bangchang had usurped the throne, many treacherous ministers urged him on. Ma Shen was the first to draft a full memorial urging Bangchang to welcome and serve Prince Kang, the marshal, without delay.

sentences.zh: 同院無肯連名者，伸獨持以往，而銀台司視書不稱臣，辭不受。

translations.literal: None in the same office would join their names to it. Shen alone carried it forth. The Silver Terrace Office, seeing that the memorial did not style itself as subject, declined to receive it.
translations.idiomatic: No one else in his office would co-sign the memorial. Ma Shen carried it alone. The Silver Terrace Office, seeing that the memorial did not use the language of a subject addressing a ruler, refused to accept it.

sentences.zh: 伸投袂叱之曰：“吾今日不愛一死，正為此耳，爾欲吾稱臣邪？”

translations.literal: Shen flung his sleeve and rebuked them, saying: "Today I do not cherish my life—precisely for this. Do you want me to style myself as subject?"
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shen flung his sleeve and shouted, "Today I do not value my life—and it is precisely for this. Do you want me to address him as my sovereign?"

sentences.zh: 即繳申尚書省，以示邦昌。

translations.literal: He immediately submitted it to the Ministry of Personnel to show Bangchang.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately forwarded it to the Ministry of Personnel to be shown to Zhang Bangchang.

sentences.zh: 其書略曰：

translations.literal: The memorial in brief says:
translations.idiomatic: The memorial in brief reads:

sentences.zh: 相公服事累朝，為宋輔臣。

translations.literal: Lord Chancellor, you have served many reigns as a minister of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Chancellor, you have served many reigns as a minister of Song.

sentences.zh: 比不幸迫於強敵，使當偽號，變出非常，相公此時豈以義為可犯，君為可忘，宗社神靈為可昧邪？

translations.literal: Recently, unfortunately forced by a powerful enemy, you were made to assume a false title in extraordinary circumstances. At that moment, could you have thought that righteousness might be violated, that your lord might be forgotten, or that the spirits of the altars of state might be disregarded?
translations.idiomatic: Recently, forced by a powerful enemy, you were made to assume a false title under extraordinary circumstances. At that moment, could you have believed that righteousness might be violated, that your sovereign might be forgotten, or that the spirits of the ancestral altars might be dishonored?

sentences.zh: 所以忍須臾死而詭聽之者，其心若曰：與其虛遜於人而實亡趙氏之宗，孰若虛受於己而實存以歸之耳。

translations.literal: The reason you endured a momentary death and feigned obedience was that in your heart you said: rather than falsely defer to others and in reality destroy the house of Zhao, better falsely to receive the title yourself and in reality preserve it to be returned.
translations.idiomatic: The reason you endured a moment of shame and feigned obedience was that in your heart you reasoned: better to accept the title falsely yourself and in fact preserve the dynasty to be restored, than to defer falsely to others and in fact let the house of Zhao perish.

sentences.zh: 忠臣義士未即就死，闔城民庶未即生變者，亦以相公必能立趙孤也。

translations.literal: That loyal ministers and righteous men did not immediately go to their deaths, and that the people throughout the city did not immediately rise in revolt, was also because they believed the Lord Chancellor would surely be able to establish the Zhao orphan.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal ministers did not immediately lay down their lives, and the people of the capital did not immediately rise in rebellion, because they believed you would surely establish the Zhao heir.

sentences.zh: 今金人北還，相公義當憂懼，自列於朝。

translations.literal: Now the Jin people have returned north. The Lord Chancellor, in righteousness, ought to be filled with worry and fear and present himself before the court.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Jin have withdrawn to the north. In righteousness you ought to be filled with anxiety and present yourself before the court.

sentences.zh: 康王在外，國統有屬，獄訟謳歌，人皆歸往。

translations.literal: Prince Kang is abroad; the imperial succession has a claimant. In lawsuits and in songs of praise, all turn toward him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Kang is abroad, and the imperial succession has a rightful heir. In every lawsuit and every song of praise, the people's hearts turn toward him.

sentences.zh: 宜即發使通問，掃清宮室，率群臣共迎而立之。

translations.literal: You should immediately dispatch envoys to greet him, sweep clean the palace chambers, and lead the ministers together to welcome and establish him.
translations.idiomatic: You should immediately send envoys to greet him, prepare the palace chambers, and lead the ministers together to welcome and establish him.

sentences.zh: 相公易服退處，省中庶事皆稟命太后，其赦書施恩惠、收人心等事，日下拘收，俟康王禦極施行。

translations.literal: The Lord Chancellor should change his robes and withdraw. All routine affairs of the Secretariat should be reported to the Empress Dowager for decision. Matters such as amnesties, bestowals of grace, and winning hearts should be stopped at once and held until Prince Kang ascends the throne to implement them.
translations.idiomatic: You should change your robes and withdraw from office. All routine affairs of the Secretariat should be referred to the Empress Dowager. Amnesties, acts of grace, and other measures to win popular support should cease immediately and wait until Prince Kang ascends the throne to be carried out.

sentences.zh: 然後相公北面引咎，以明身為人臣，昧於防患，遭寇仇脅汙，當時不能即死，以待陛下，今復何面目事君，請歸死司寇，為人臣失節之戒，伏闕下俟命。

translations.literal: Then the Lord Chancellor should face north, confess his fault, and make clear that as a minister he was blind to danger, was coerced and defiled by the enemy, and could not die at once while waiting for Your Majesty. Now with what face can he serve his lord? He asks to return and die before the Minister of Justice as a warning to ministers who fail in their duty, and kneels at the palace gate awaiting command.
translations.idiomatic: Then you should turn northward, confess your fault, and declare that as a minister you failed to foresee the danger, were coerced and defiled by the enemy, and could not die immediately while waiting for the emperor's return. With what face can you now serve your sovereign? I ask that you go and accept death before the Minister of Justice as a warning to all faithless ministers, and kneel at the palace gate awaiting judgment.

sentences.zh: 如此，則明主必能察相公忠實存國，義非苟生，且棄過而錄功矣。

translations.literal: In this way the wise ruler will surely be able to discern that the Lord Chancellor loyally sought to preserve the state, that his righteousness was not reckless clinging to life, and will discard his fault and record his merit.
translations.idiomatic: In this way the wise ruler will surely see that you loyally sought to preserve the state, that your righteousness was not mere clinging to life, and will overlook your fault and honor your service.

sentences.zh: 今乃謀不出此，時日已多，肆然尚當非據，偃寢禁闥，若固有之。

translations.literal: Yet now the plan does not follow this course. Many days have already passed, and you brazenly continue to occupy a position that is not rightfully yours, sleeping within the forbidden palace as though it were your own.
translations.idiomatic: Yet now you follow no such course. Many days have passed, and you brazenly continue to hold a throne that is not rightfully yours, sleeping within the forbidden palace as though it belonged to you.

sentences.zh: 群心狐疑，道路混澒，謂相公方挾強金，使人遊說康王，姑令南遁，為久假不歸之計。

translations.literal: Public hearts are suspicious; the roads are in confusion. People say the Lord Chancellor, relying on Jin strength, has sent envoys to persuade Prince Kang, temporarily ordering him to flee south as a long-term plan of borrowed rule without return.
translations.idiomatic: Public opinion is divided and the roads are in turmoil. People say you rely on Jin power, send envoys to persuade Prince Kang to flee south for the time being, and plan to keep the throne indefinitely without returning it.

sentences.zh: 上天難欺，下民可畏。

translations.literal: Heaven is hard to deceive; the common people are to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven cannot be deceived, and the common people are not to be trifled with.

sentences.zh: 相公若以愚言粗知覺悟，及此改圖，猶可轉禍為福於匪朝伊夕之間。

translations.literal: If the Lord Chancellor, through my crude words, can somewhat awaken and change his course at this point, he may still turn calamity into fortune in no more than a morning or an evening.
translations.idiomatic: If you can take my plain words to heart, awaken now, and change course, you may still turn disaster into blessing in no more than a day.

sentences.zh: 過此以往，則相公包藏已深，誌慮轉異，外飾事端，悽日待期，而陰結寇仇，合從為亂，九廟在天，萬無成理，伸必不能輔相公為宋朝叛臣也。

translations.literal: Beyond this, then the Lord Chancellor's hidden designs would already be deep, his aims and thoughts would turn different, outwardly adorning pretexts, day by day awaiting the appointed time, while secretly allying with the enemy and joining in rebellion. With the nine ancestral temples in Heaven, there would be no possibility of success. Shen certainly cannot assist the Lord Chancellor in becoming a traitorous minister of the Song dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond that lies only deeper conspiracy and changed intent—outward pretexts, day by day awaiting the moment, while secretly allying with the enemy and plotting rebellion. With the ancestral spirits watching from Heaven, success would be impossible. I cannot help you become a traitor to Song.

sentences.zh: 請先伏死都市，以明此心。”

translations.literal: I ask first to lay down my life in the capital market, to make clear this heart.
translations.idiomatic: I ask only to die first in the capital marketplace, so that my loyalty may be made plain.

sentences.zh: 邦昌得書，氣沮謀喪。

translations.literal: Bangchang received the memorial; his spirit flagged and his plans collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bangchang received the memorial; his spirit collapsed and his schemes fell apart.

sentences.zh: 明日，議迎哲宗後孟氏垂簾，追還偽赦，乃遣馮澥、李回等迎康王。

translations.literal: The next day they deliberated on welcoming Empress Meng, consort of Emperor Zhezong, to hold court from behind the curtain, rescinded the false amnesty, and dispatched Feng Xie, Li Hui, and others to welcome Prince Kang.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the court resolved to welcome Empress Meng, widow of Emperor Zhezong, to rule from behind the curtain, revoked the false amnesty, and sent Feng Xie, Li Hui, and others to welcome Prince Kang.

sentences.zh: 時王及之等猶請籍龍德宮寶貨，斥賣靈沼魚藕，以資官用。

translations.literal: At that time Wang Jizhi and others still requested that the treasures of Longde Palace be inventoried and the fish and lotus roots of Ling Pond sold to supply official expenses.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wang Jizhi and others still urged that the treasures of Longde Palace be catalogued and the fish and lotus roots of Ling Pond sold to fund the government.

sentences.zh: 伸復慨然引義檄之曰：“古者人臣去國，三年不反，然後收其田裏。

translations.literal: Shen again, filled with indignation, cited righteousness and rebuked them in a proclamation, saying: "In antiquity, when a minister left his state, after three years without returning his fields and homestead were then confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shen again, indignant, cited precedent and rebuked them in a memorial: "In antiquity, when a minister left his state, only after three years without return were his fields and homestead confiscated.

sentences.zh: 君之禮臣如此，臣之報君宜如何？

translations.literal: If a lord treats his ministers thus, how should ministers repay their lord?
translations.idiomatic: If a sovereign treats his ministers thus, how should ministers repay their sovereign?

sentences.zh: 今二聖遠狩，猶未出境，天下之人方且北首，欲追挽而還之。

translations.literal: Now the Two Emperors are driven far on campaign and have not yet left enemy territory. The people of the realm are still turning their faces north, wishing to seize and draw them back.
translations.idiomatic: Now the two emperors are held captive far away and have not yet left enemy territory. The people of the realm still turn northward, longing to bring them home.

sentences.zh: 君之府藏燕遊，忍一朝而毀乎？

translations.literal: Can you bear in a single morning to destroy your lord's storehouses and places of pleasure?
translations.idiomatic: Can you bear to destroy your sovereign's treasuries and pleasure grounds in a single morning?

sentences.zh: 爾等逆節甚矣！”

translations.literal: Your rebellious conduct is extreme!"
translations.idiomatic: Your treason is outrageous!"

sentences.zh: 力爭乃止。

translations.literal: Through strenuous protest it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Through his forceful protest the plan was halted.

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，伸拜章以城陷不能救，主遷不能死，請就竄削。

translations.literal: When Gaozong ascended the throne, Shen submitted a memorial that because the city had fallen he could not save it and because the sovereign had moved he did not die, he asked to accept demotion and exile.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gaozong took the throne, Ma Shen submitted a memorial saying that because he had failed to save the capital when it fell and had not died when the sovereign was taken captive, he asked to accept demotion and exile.

sentences.zh: 上知其有忠力於國，擢殿中侍御史，撫諭荊湖、廣南，以誅邦昌及其黨王時雍等。

translations.literal: The emperor knew that he had shown loyal strength for the state and promoted him to Palace Attendant Censor. He was sent to soothe Jinghu and Guangnan and to execute Bangchang and his faction, including Wang Shiyong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor knew he had served the state with loyal force and promoted him to Palace Attendant Censor, sending him to pacify Jinghu and Guangnan and to execute Zhang Bangchang and his faction, including Wang Shiyong.

sentences.zh: 所過州縣，諏察吏之賢否與民利疚，以次列上於朝。

translations.literal: In every prefecture and county he passed through, he investigated whether officials were worthy or not and what benefited or harmed the people, and submitted reports to the court in order.
translations.idiomatic: In every prefecture and county he passed through, he investigated the merit of officials and the welfare or harm of the people, reporting his findings to the court in due order.

sentences.zh: 伸自湖、廣將入奏黃潛善、汪伯彥不法凡十有七事，草疏已具，朝廷方召孫覿、謝克家，乃先奏：“覿、克家趨操不正，在靖康間與王時雍、王及之等七人結為死黨，附耿南仲倡為和議，助成賊謀。

translations.literal: As Shen was about to enter the capital from Hunan and Guangdong to memorialize seventeen instances of Huang Qianshan's and Wang Boyan's unlawful conduct, having already drafted the memorial, the court was just then summoning Sun Jue and Xie Kejia. He therefore submitted first: "Jue and Kejia are unprincipled in conduct. During the Jingkang era they joined Wang Shiyong, Wang Jizhi, and five others in a sworn faction, attached themselves to Geng Zhongzhong in advocating peace, and helped carry out the enemy's designs.
translations.idiomatic: As Ma Shen was returning from Hunan and Guangdong to memorialize seventeen instances of misconduct by Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan, his draft already complete, the court was summoning Sun Jue and Xie Kejia. He submitted first: "Jue and Kejia are unprincipled. During the Jingkang era they joined Wang Shiyong, Wang Jizhi, and five others in a sworn faction, attached themselves to Geng Zhongzhong in advocating peace, and helped the enemy's designs.

sentences.zh: 有不主和議者，則欲執送金人。

translations.literal: Those who did not advocate peace they wished to seize and hand over to the Jin people.
translations.idiomatic: Those who opposed peace they wished to seize and hand over to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 覿受金人女樂，草表媚之，極其筆力，乃負國之賊，宜加遠竄。”

translations.literal: Jue received female musicians from the Jin people and drafted a flattering memorial to them with all his literary skill. He is a traitor to the state and should be exiled far away."
translations.idiomatic: Jue accepted female musicians from the Jin and drafted a fawning memorial to them with all his literary skill. He is a traitor to the state and should be exiled far away."

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: There was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: The court gave no reply.

sentences.zh: 伸又進疏曰：

translations.literal: Shen again submitted a memorial, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shen then submitted another memorial:

sentences.zh: 陛下得黃潛善、汪伯彥以為輔相，委任不復疑。

translations.literal: Your Majesty obtained Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan as chief ministers and entrusted them without further doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty appointed Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan as chief ministers and entrusted them without further doubt.

sentences.zh: 然自入相以來，處事未嚐愜當物情，遂使女真日強，盜賊日熾，國本日蹙，威權日削。

translations.literal: Yet from the time they entered office, in handling affairs they have never once satisfied public sentiment, so that the Jurchen grow stronger day by day, bandits grow fiercer day by day, the foundation of the state is pressed tighter day by day, and imperial authority is cut down day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from the day they took office their conduct has never satisfied public sentiment: the Jurchen grow stronger daily, banditry spreads daily, the foundations of the state weaken daily, and imperial authority shrinks daily.

sentences.zh: 且三鎮未服，汴都方危，前日遽下還都之詔，至今鑾輿未能順動。

translations.literal: Moreover the Three Prefectures are not yet pacified and Bian capital is still in peril. Recently an edict to return to the capital was hastily issued, yet to this day the imperial carriage has not been able to move in accordance.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Prefectures remain unpacified and the capital is still in peril. An edict to return to the capital was issued hastily, yet the imperial carriage still has not moved accordingly.

sentences.zh: 其不謹詔命如此。

translations.literal: Their lack of respect for imperial commands is such as this.
translations.idiomatic: Such is their disregard for imperial commands.

sentences.zh: 草茅對策不如式，考官罰金可矣，一日黜三舍人，乃取沈晦、孫覿、黃哲輩諸群小以掌誥命。

translations.literal: In the commoners' policy examination answers, failure to follow the prescribed form would merit only a fine for the examiner; yet in a single day three Secretariat Drafters were dismissed and Shen Hui, Sun Jue, Huang Zhe, and other petty men were taken to manage edicts and decrees.
translations.idiomatic: When commoners' examination answers failed to follow form, a fine for the examiner would suffice; yet in a single day three Secretariat Drafters were dismissed and Shen Hui, Sun Jue, Huang Zhe, and other petty men were installed to manage edicts and decrees.

sentences.zh: 其黜陟不公如此。

translations.literal: Their unfair promotions and dismissals are such as this.
translations.idiomatic: Such is their unfairness in appointments and dismissals.

sentences.zh: 吳給、張訚以言事被逐，邵成章緣上言遠竄。

translations.literal: Wu Ge and Zhang Yan were driven out for speaking on affairs; Shao Chengzhang was exiled far away for submitting a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Ge and Zhang Yan were driven out for speaking on state affairs; Shao Chengzhang was exiled far away for submitting a memorial.

sentences.zh: 其壅塞言路如此。

translations.literal: Their blocking of the avenue of remonstrance is such as this.
translations.idiomatic: Such is their choking off of free speech.

sentences.zh: 祖宗舊制，諫官御史有闕，御史中丞、翰林學士具名以進，三省不敢預，厥有深旨。

translations.literal: By the old institutions of the ancestors, when remonstrance and censorial offices were vacant, the censor-in-chief and Hanlin Academician submitted names for advancement; the Three Departments dared not intervene. This had profound intent.
translations.idiomatic: By ancestral institution, when remonstrance and censorial posts fell vacant, the censor-in-chief and Hanlin Academician submitted names; the Three Departments dared not intervene. This had profound purpose.

sentences.zh: 近擬用台諫，多取親舊，不過欲為己助。

translations.literal: Recently in proposing censorial and remonstrance appointments, they have mostly taken relatives and intimates, intending only to secure help for themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Recently in proposing censorial and remonstrance appointments they have mostly chosen relatives and intimates, intending only to secure allies for themselves.

sentences.zh: 其毀法自恣如此。

translations.literal: Their destruction of law and self-willed conduct are such as this.
translations.idiomatic: Such is their destruction of law and self-willed conduct.

sentences.zh: 張愨、宗澤、許景衡公忠有才，皆可任重，潛善、伯彥忌之，沮抑至死。

translations.literal: Zhang Xuan, Zong Ze, and Xu Jingheng were loyal and public-spirited and talented; all could bear heavy responsibility. Qianshan and Boyan envied them and suppressed them until death.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xuan, Zong Ze, and Xu Jingheng were loyal, talented, and fit for heavy responsibility. Qianshan and Boyan envied them and suppressed them until they died.

sentences.zh: 其妨功害能如此。

translations.literal: Their obstruction of merit and harm to the capable are such as this.
translations.idiomatic: Such is their obstruction of merit and harm to the capable.

sentences.zh: 或責以救焚拯溺之事，則曰難言，蓋謂陛下製之不得施設也。

translations.literal: When charged with matters of rescuing from fire and saving from drowning, they would say it was difficult to speak of, meaning that Your Majesty restrained them so they could not act.
translations.idiomatic: When charged with urgent rescue of the state, they would say it was difficult to speak of—meaning that Your Majesty restrained them so they could not act.

sentences.zh: 或問陳東之死，則曰不知，蓋謂其事繇於陛下也。

translations.literal: When asked about Chen Dong's death, they would say they did not know, meaning that the affair arose from Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: When asked about Chen Dong's death, they would say they did not know—meaning that the affair arose from Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 其過則稱君、善則稱己如此。

translations.literal: When there was fault they attributed it to the ruler; when there was merit they claimed it for themselves—such as this.
translations.idiomatic: They attributed faults to the ruler and claimed merit for themselves—such was their conduct.

sentences.zh: 呂源狂橫，陛下逐去，不數月由郡守升發運。

translations.literal: Lü Yuan was insolent and overbearing; Your Majesty drove him away, yet within a few months he was promoted from prefect to transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yuan was insolent and overbearing; Your Majesty drove him away, yet within months he was promoted from prefect to transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 其強狠自專如此。

translations.literal: Their fierce self-will is such as this.
translations.idiomatic: Such is their fierce self-will.

sentences.zh: 禦營使雖主兵權，凡行在諸軍皆其所統，潛善、伯彥別置親兵一千人，請給居處，優於眾兵。

translations.literal: Although the commissioner of the Imperial Camp held military authority and all armies at the temporary capital were under his command, Qianshan and Boyan separately established a personal guard of one thousand men, requesting quarters and provisions superior to the rest of the army.
translations.idiomatic: Although the Imperial Camp commissioner held military authority over all armies at the temporary capital, Qianshan and Boyan separately established a personal guard of one thousand men, requesting quarters and provisions superior to the rest.

sentences.zh: 其務收軍情如此。

translations.literal: Their effort to win military favor is such as this.
translations.idiomatic: Such is their effort to win military favor.

sentences.zh: 廣市私恩，則多復祠官之闕；

translations.literal: To spread private favor widely, they restored many vacant sinecure posts.
translations.idiomatic: To spread private favor widely, they restored many vacant sinecure posts.

sentences.zh: 同惡相濟，則力庇王安中之罪。

translations.literal: Evil men aiding one another, they strenuously shielded Wang Anzhong's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: As evil men aiding one another, they strenuously shielded Wang Anzhong's crimes.

sentences.zh: 摭其所為，豈不辜陛下倚任之重哉？

translations.literal: Gathering their conduct together, have they not betrayed the weight of Your Majesty's trust?
translations.idiomatic: Gathering their conduct together, have they not betrayed the weight of Your Majesty's trust?

sentences.zh: 陛下隱忍不肯斥逐，塗炭遺民固已絕望，二聖還期在何時邪？

translations.literal: Your Majesty forbearingly refuses to dismiss and drive them out. The suffering people are already in despair. When will the Two Emperors return?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty forbearingly refuses to dismiss them. The suffering people are already in despair. When will the two emperors return?

sentences.zh: 臣每念此，不如無生。

translations.literal: Whenever your subject thinks of this, death would be better than life.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever I think of this, death seems better than life.

sentences.zh: 歲月如流，時幾易失，望速罷潛善、伯彥政柄，別選賢者，共圖大事。

translations.literal: Years flow like water and opportunities easily slip away. I pray that you quickly remove Qianshan and Boyan from power, select other worthy men, and together plan great affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Years flow like water and opportunities slip away easily. I beg Your Majesty to remove Qianshan and Boyan from power at once, select other worthy men, and together plan the nation's recovery.

sentences.zh: 疏入，留中。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, it was retained at court.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, it was retained at court without action.

sentences.zh: 明日，改衛尉少卿。

translations.literal: The next day he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 伸以論事不行，辭不拜，錄其疏申御史台，且疊上章言：“臣言可采，即乞施行，若臣言非是，合坐誣罔之罪。”

translations.literal: Shen, because his remonstrance had not been carried out, declined to accept appointment. He recorded his memorial and submitted it to the Censorate, and repeatedly submitted memorials saying: "If my words may be adopted, I pray they be implemented. If my words are not correct, I ought to bear the crime of false accusation."
translations.idiomatic: Because his remonstrance had not been heeded, Ma Shen declined the appointment. He filed his memorial with the Censorate and repeatedly submitted memorials saying, "If my words may be adopted, let them be implemented. If my words are wrong, I ought to bear the crime of false accusation."

sentences.zh: 移疾待命。

translations.literal: He reported illness and awaited command.
translations.idiomatic: He reported illness and awaited the court's decision.

sentences.zh: 旬日，詔伸言事不實，送吏部責濮州監酒稅。

translations.literal: Within ten days an edict declared that Shen's words on affairs were not factual and sent him to the Ministry of Personnel to be punished with supervision of wine tax at Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Within ten days an edict declared that Ma Shen's charges were unfounded and sent him to the Ministry of Personnel to be punished with supervision of wine tax at Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 時用事者恚甚，必欲殺之，以濮迫寇境，故有是命。

translations.literal: At that time those in power were exceedingly angry and wished certainly to kill him. Because Pu was close to enemy territory, there was this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Those in power were exceedingly angry and wished certainly to kill him. Because Puzhou lay close to enemy territory, this appointment was made.

sentences.zh: 趣使上道，伸怡然袱被而行，死道中。

translations.literal: Urged to take up his post on the road, Shen calmly wrapped his bedding and set out, and died on the way.
translations.idiomatic: Urged to depart at once, Ma Shen calmly wrapped his bedding and set out, and died on the road.

sentences.zh: 或曰王淵在濮，潛善密嗾其不利於伸。

translations.literal: Some say Wang Yuan was at Pu and Qianshan secretly instructed him to do harm to Shen.
translations.idiomatic: Some say Wang Yuan was at Puzhou and Huang Qianshan secretly instructed him to do harm to Ma Shen.

sentences.zh: 天下識與不識皆冤痛之。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm, whether they knew him or not, all grieved for him as for a wrongful death.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the realm, whether they knew him or not, all grieved for him as for a wrongful death.

sentences.zh: 明年，金人陷廣陵，伸言始驗，潛善、伯彥始以誤國竄殛。

translations.literal: The next year, when the Jin people took Guangling, Shen's words were verified and Qianshan and Boyan were at last exiled and executed for misleading the state.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, when the Jin took Guangling, Ma Shen's warnings were vindicated and Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan were at last exiled and executed for misleading the state.

sentences.zh: 於是台臣奏伸嚐論潛善等罪，乃復以衛尉少卿召，實未知其存亡也。

translations.literal: Thereupon censorial officials memorialized that Shen had once discussed the crimes of Qianshan and others, and he was again summoned as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments—in fact not knowing whether he was alive or dead.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials then memorialized that Ma Shen had once indicted Qianshan and others, and he was again summoned as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments—not knowing whether he was still alive.

sentences.zh: 尋加直龍圖閣。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was further granted direct appointment to the Dragon Diagram Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was further granted direct appointment to the Dragon Diagram Hall.

sentences.zh: 紹興初，胡安國上《時政論》，有曰：“伸言潛善、伯彥措置乖方，條其罪狀，凡舉一事，必立一證，皆眾所共知共見，不敢以無為有，以是為非。

translations.literal: In the early Shaoxing era, Hu Anguo submitted a Discourse on Current Policy, saying: "Shen spoke of the improper arrangements of Qianshan and Boyan and listed their crimes. For each matter he raised he established evidence; all were what the multitude jointly knew and jointly saw. He did not dare to treat what was not as what was, or treat what was as what was not.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shaoxing era, Hu Anguo submitted a Discourse on Current Policy, writing: "Ma Shen indicted the improper conduct of Qianshan and Boyan and listed their crimes. For each charge he established evidence known and seen by all. He did not dare to invent or deny facts.

sentences.zh: 而當時曾不從用，反以為言事不實而重責之，是罰沮忠讜，邪說何由而息，公道何由而明乎？

translations.literal: Yet at that time the court did not follow his advice and on the contrary punished him heavily for speaking on affairs not in accordance with fact. This was to penalize and discourage loyal remonstrance. How then could heterodox doctrines cease and public justice be made clear?
translations.idiomatic: Yet the court did not follow his advice and instead punished him heavily for unfounded charges. This penalized loyal remonstrance. How then could heterodox doctrines cease and justice prevail?

sentences.zh: 伸既遠貶，雖有詔命，邈無來期，君子閔焉。

translations.literal: After Shen was exiled far away, although there were edicts and appointments, there was no prospect of his return. Men of principle grieved for him.
translations.idiomatic: After Ma Shen was exiled far away, although edicts and appointments followed, there was no prospect of his return. Men of principle grieved for him.

sentences.zh: 賁以龍圖，猶未盡褒勸之典。

translations.literal: To honor him with the Dragon Diagram Hall was still not the full measure of commendation and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Honoring him with the Dragon Diagram Hall still fell short of the full measure of commendation he deserved.

sentences.zh: 乞重加追獎，及其子孫，以承天意。”

translations.literal: I pray that heavier posthumous rewards be granted to him and his descendants, to accord with Heaven's intent."
translations.idiomatic: I pray that heavier posthumous rewards be granted to him and his descendants, to accord with Heaven's intent."

sentences.zh: 詔贈諫議大夫。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously granted him Remonstrance and Policy Adviser.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously granted him the title Remonstrance and Policy Adviser.

sentences.zh: 伸天資純確，學問有原委，勇於為義，而所韞深厚，恥以自名。

translations.literal: Shen's inborn nature was pure and certain; his learning had root and source. He was courageous in righteousness, yet what he stored within was deep and thick; he was ashamed to make a name for himself.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shen's nature was pure and steadfast; his learning had deep roots. He was courageous in righteousness, yet his inner reserves were profound and he was ashamed to seek fame.

sentences.zh: 建炎初，右正言鄧肅嚐論朝士臣邦昌者，例貶二秩，伸不辨也。

translations.literal: In the early Jianyan era, the Right Remonstrance Adviser Deng Su once discussed court officials who had served Bangchang; by precedent they were demoted two ranks. Shen did not defend himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Jianyan era, the Right Remonstrance Adviser Deng Su discussed court officials who had served Zhang Bangchang; by precedent they were demoted two ranks. Ma Shen did not defend himself.

sentences.zh: 凡有建明，輒削其稿，人罕知之。

translations.literal: Whenever he had proposals to make, he would cut away the drafts; few people knew of them.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he made proposals, he destroyed the drafts; few knew of his contributions.

sentences.zh: 居官，晨興必整衣端坐，讀《中庸》一遍，然後出涖事。

translations.literal: In office, every morning on rising he would straighten his garments and sit upright, read through the Doctrine of the Mean once, and only then go out to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In office, every morning he straightened his garments, sat upright, read through the Doctrine of the Mean once, and only then went out to handle affairs.

sentences.zh: 每曰：“ 吾誌在行道。

translations.literal: He often said: "My aim is to walk in the Way.
translations.idiomatic: He often said, "My aim is to walk in the Way.

sentences.zh: 以富貴為心，則為富貴所累；

translations.literal: If one takes wealth and honor as one's heart, one is bound by wealth and honor.
translations.idiomatic: If one takes wealth and honor as one's heart, one is bound by wealth and honor.

sentences.zh: 以妻子為念，則為妻子所奪，道不可行也。”

translations.literal: If one takes wife and children as one's thought, one is seized by wife and children; the Way cannot be walked."
translations.idiomatic: If one takes wife and children as one's thought, one is seized by wife and children—the Way cannot be walked."

sentences.zh: 故在廣陵，行篋一簷，圖書半之。

translations.literal: Therefore at Guangling his traveling chest had but one shelf, and books filled half of it.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore at Guangling his traveling chest held but one shelf, and books filled half of it.

sentences.zh: 山東已擾，家尚留於鄆。

translations.literal: Shandong was already in turmoil; his family still remained in Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong was already in turmoil; his family still remained in Yan.

sentences.zh: 常稱：“孔子言：‘誌士不忘在溝壑，勇士不忘喪其元。

translations.literal: He often quoted: "Confucius said: 'The man of resolve does not forget that he may end in ditches and gullies; the man of courage does not forget that he may lose his head.'
translations.idiomatic: He often quoted Confucius: "The man of resolve does not forget that he may end in ditches and gullies; the man of courage does not forget that he may lose his head."

sentences.zh: ’今日何日，溝壑乃吾死所也。”

translations.literal: What day is today? The ditches and gullies are where I shall die.
translations.idiomatic: What day is today? The ditches and gullies are where I shall die.

sentences.zh: 有何兌者，昭武人，受學於伸。

translations.literal: There was one He Dui, a native of Zhaowu, who received instruction from Shen.
translations.idiomatic: There was one He Dui, a native of Zhaowu, who had studied under Ma Shen.

sentences.zh: 伸沒，兌嚐輯其事狀。

translations.literal: After Shen died, Dui once compiled an account of his deeds.
translations.idiomatic: After Ma Shen died, He Dui compiled an account of his deeds.

sentences.zh: 紹興中，為辰州通判，都郵報，秦檜自陳其存趙之功，謂它人莫預。

translations.literal: During the Shaoxing era he was vice prefect of Chenzhou. The capital courier reported that Qin Hui himself stated his merit in preserving the Zhao house, saying that others had no part in it.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaoxing era he served as vice prefect of Chenzhou. The capital courier reported that Qin Hui himself claimed credit for preserving the Zhao dynasty, saying that others had no part in it.

sentences.zh: 兌徑取所輯事狀達尚書省，檜大怒，下兌荊南詔獄，獄辭皆出吏手，兌坐削官竄真陽。

translations.literal: Dui directly took the compiled account of deeds and sent it to the Ministry of Personnel. Hui was greatly enraged and had Dui thrown into the Jingnan imperial prison. The prison documents were all written by clerks' hands; Dui was punished with removal from office and exile to Zhenyang.
translations.idiomatic: He Dui took the compiled account directly to the Ministry of Personnel. Qin Hui was enraged and had him thrown into the Jingnan imperial prison. The prison documents were all written by clerks; He Dui was stripped of office and exiled to Zhenyang.

sentences.zh: 檜死始放還，復其官。

translations.literal: After Hui died he was at last released and his office restored.
translations.idiomatic: After Qin Hui died he was at last released and his office restored.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he died.

sentences.zh: 呂祖儉字子約，祖謙之弟也，受業祖謙如諸生。

translations.literal: Lü Zujian, courtesy name Ziyue, was the younger brother of Lü Zuqian. He received instruction from Zuqian as other students did.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Zujian, courtesy name Ziyue, was the younger brother of Lü Zuqian. He studied under Zuqian as other students did.

sentences.zh: 監明州倉，將上，會祖謙卒。

translations.literal: He was supervising the Mingzhou granary and was about to report for duty when Zuqian died.
translations.idiomatic: He was supervising the Mingzhou granary and was about to report for duty when Zuqian died.

sentences.zh: 部法半年不上者為違年，祖儉必欲終期喪，朝廷從之，詔違年者以一年為限，自祖儉始。

translations.literal: By ministry law, one who did not report within half a year was in violation of the year limit. Zujian insisted on completing the full mourning period. The court acceded; an edict declared that for violation of the year limit one year would be the limit, beginning with Zujian.
translations.idiomatic: By ministry law, failure to report within half a year counted as violation of the term limit. Zujian insisted on completing the full mourning period. The court acceded and decreed that violators would be allowed one year, beginning with Zujian.

sentences.zh: 終更赴銓，丞相周必大語尚書尤袤招之，祖儉已調衢州法曹而後往見。

translations.literal: When his term ended he went for appointment review. Chief Minister Zhou Bida told Minister of Personnel You Mao to summon him. Zujian had already been assigned to Quzhou legal bureau and went to see him only afterward.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ended he went for appointment review. Chief Minister Zhou Bida told Minister of Personnel You Mao to summon him. Zujian had already been assigned to the Quzhou legal bureau and went to see him only afterward.

sentences.zh: 潘時經略廣東，欲辟為屬，祖儉辭。

translations.literal: Pan Shi was pacification commissioner of Guangdong and wished to recruit him as staff. Zujian declined.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Shi was pacification commissioner of Guangdong and wished to recruit him as staff. Zujian declined.

sentences.zh: 尋以侍從鄭僑、張杓、羅點、諸葛庭瑞薦，召除籍田令。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, on recommendation of attendant officials Zheng Qiao, Zhang Biao, Luo Dian, and Zhuge Tingrui, he was summoned and appointed Recorder of the Imperial Fields.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, on recommendation of attendant officials Zheng Qiao, Zhang Biao, Luo Dian, and Zhuge Tingrui, he was summoned and appointed Recorder of the Imperial Fields.

sentences.zh: 中丞何澹所生父繼室周氏死，澹欲服伯母服，下太常百官雜議。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief He Dan's father's concubine after remarriage, Lady Zhou, died. Dan wished to wear mourning for an elder brother's wife. The Directorate of Sacrifices had all officials discuss the matter together.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief He Dan's father's concubine after remarriage, Lady Zhou, died. Dan wished to wear mourning for an elder brother's wife. The Directorate of Sacrifices had all officials discuss the matter together.

sentences.zh: 祖儉貽書宰相曰：“《禮》曰：‘為伋也妻者，是為白也母。

translations.literal: Zujian sent a letter to the chief minister saying: "The Rites says: 'For one who marries the younger son's wife, this is making her mother to the elder son Bai.'
translations.idiomatic: Zujian sent a letter to the chief minister saying, "The Rites says: 'For one who marries the younger son's wife, this is making her mother to the elder son Bai.'

sentences.zh: ’今周氏非中丞父之妻乎？

translations.literal: Is not Lady Zhou the wife of the censor-in-chief's father?
translations.idiomatic: Is not Lady Zhou the wife of the censor-in-chief's father?

sentences.zh: 將不謂之母而謂之何？

translations.literal: If you will not call her mother, what will you call her?
translations.idiomatic: If you will not call her mother, what will you call her?

sentences.zh: 中丞為風憲首，而以不孝令，百僚何觀焉。”

translations.literal: The censor-in-chief is head of the censorial bureau; yet by unfilial command, what will the hundred officials look to?"
translations.idiomatic: The censor-in-chief heads the censorial bureau; yet by this unfilial command, what example will the hundred officials follow?"

sentences.zh: 除司農簿，已而乞補外，通判台州。

translations.literal: He was appointed Registrar of the Directorate of Agriculture; shortly afterward he requested an outer appointment and was made Vice Prefect of Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Registrar of the Directorate of Agriculture; shortly afterward he requested an outer appointment and was made Vice Prefect of Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 寧宗即位，除太府丞。

translations.literal: When Ningzong ascended the throne, he was appointed Vice Director of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ningzong took the throne, he was appointed Vice Director of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 時韓侂胄浸用事，正言李沐論右相趙汝愚罷之。

translations.literal: At that time Han Tuozhou was gradually gaining power. Remonstrance Adviser Li Mu memorialized to dismiss the right chief minister Zhao Ruyu.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Han Tuozhou was gradually gaining power. Remonstrance Adviser Li Mu memorialized to dismiss the right chief minister Zhao Ruyu.

sentences.zh: 祖儉奏：“汝愚亦不得無過，然未至如言者所雲。”

translations.literal: Zujian memorialized: "Ruyu too cannot be without fault, yet he has not reached what the speaker says."
translations.idiomatic: Zujian memorialized, "Ruyu too cannot be without fault, yet he has not reached what the accuser claims."

sentences.zh: 侂胄怒曰：“呂寺丞乃預我事邪？”

translations.literal: Tuozhou angrily said: "Does Vice Director Lü of the Temple presume to meddle in my affairs?"
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou said angrily, "Does Vice Director Lü of the Temple presume to meddle in my affairs?"

sentences.zh: 會祭酒李祥、博士楊簡皆上書訟汝愚，沐皆劾罷之。

translations.literal: When Libationer Li Xiang and Erudite Yang Jian both submitted memorials in defense of Ruyu, Mu memorialized to have them all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When Libationer Li Xiang and Erudite Yang Jian both submitted memorials in defense of Ruyu, Li Mu memorialized to have them all dismissed.

sentences.zh: 祖儉乃上封事曰：“陛下初政清明，登用忠良，然曾未逾時，朱熹老儒也，有所論列，則亟使之去；

translations.literal: Zujian thereupon submitted a sealed memorial, saying: "Your Majesty's initial government is clear and bright; you employ the loyal and worthy. Yet in no more than a season, Zhu Xi, an old Confucian, whenever he offered criticism was immediately made to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Zujian then submitted a sealed memorial, saying, "Your Majesty's initial government is clear and bright; you employ the loyal and worthy. Yet in no more than a season, Zhu Xi, an elder Confucian, whenever he offered criticism was immediately made to leave.

sentences.zh: 彭龜年舊學也，有所論列，亦亟許之去；

translations.literal: Peng Guinian was also of the old study circle; whenever he offered criticism, he too was promptly allowed to leave;
translations.idiomatic: Peng Guinian, too, was a member of Your Majesty's old study circle; whenever he offered criticism, he was likewise promptly allowed to leave.

sentences.zh: 至於李祥老成篤實，非有偏比，蓋眾聽所共孚者，今又終於斥逐。

translations.literal: As for Li Xiang, mature, steady, and honest, without partiality or faction, trusted by all who heard him—now he too has ended in expulsion.
translations.idiomatic: As for Li Xiang—mature, steady, and honest, without partiality or faction, trusted by all who heard him—he too has now been driven out.

sentences.zh: 臣恐自是天下有當言之事，必將相視以為戒，鉗口結舌之風一成而未易反，是豈國家之利邪？”

translations.literal: Your servant fears that henceforth, whenever matters in the realm ought to be spoken of, men will look to one another for warning; once the habit of silencing speech takes hold it will not easily be reversed—is this really to the nation's benefit?
translations.idiomatic: I fear that from now on, whenever something in the realm ought to be said, men will look to one another for warning and hold their tongues; once the habit of silenced speech takes hold, it will not easily be reversed—is that truly to the nation's benefit?

sentences.zh: 又曰：“今之能言之士，其所難非在於得罪君父，而在忤意權勢。

translations.literal: He also said: "Among those who dare speak today, what they fear is not offending their sovereign and father, but crossing those who wield power.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Among those who dare speak today, what they fear is not offending their sovereign and father, but crossing those who wield power.

sentences.zh: 姑以臣所知者言之，難莫難於論災異，然言之而不諱者，以其事不關於權勢也。

translations.literal: To speak from what I know: nothing is harder than to discuss portents and anomalies—yet those who speak without restraint do so because such matters have nothing to do with the powerful.
translations.idiomatic: To speak from what I know: nothing is harder than discussing portents and anomalies—yet those who speak without restraint do so because such matters have nothing to do with the powerful.

sentences.zh: 若乃御筆之降，廟堂不敢重違，台諫不敢深論，給、舍不敢固執，蓋以其事關貴幸，深慮乘間激發而重得罪也。
